input.summary: Carve a limited, non-revocable servicing-platform licence out of the Servicer's blanket refusal to license its processes and software on transition
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 7.5(b) currently lets the Servicer withhold any licence of its servicing processes, models and software from us and any Successor Servicer, leaving no path for our affiliates or the contractors who would actually run servicing; our playbook requires a licence extending to affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf that is not revocable at will and is transferable to a successor. We have added a narrow grant limited to servicing the Receivables and expressly subject to the Servicer's third-party and legal restrictions, and we can accept affiliates being added on written notice if that is easier.

ops.oldText: The Servicer will not be obligated to provide, license or assign its processes, procedures, models, servicing software or other applications to any Successor Servicer or any third party, or provide anything covered by a restriction on transfer or assignment or a confidentiality agreement or otherwise restricted by legal, regulatory, privacy or data protection policies.
ops.newText: Except as provided in the following sentence, the Servicer will not be obligated to provide, license or assign its processes, procedures, models, servicing software or other applications to any Successor Servicer or any third party, or provide anything covered by a restriction on transfer or assignment or a confidentiality agreement or otherwise restricted by legal, regulatory, privacy or data protection policies. To the extent the Servicer is legally and contractually able to do so, the Servicer grants to the Issuer, the Indenture Trustee, any Successor Servicer and their respective Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf a non-exclusive license, transferable to any subsequent Successor Servicer and revocable only for a material breach of this Section 7.5(b) that remains uncured for thirty (30) days after notice, to use the Servicer's processes, procedures, models, servicing software and other applications solely as necessary to service and administer the Receivables following the Servicer's resignation or termination.
